answer: Bonded vouching defeats sybils by pricing identity. To join, a new agent must be backed by an existing member who locks collateral; if the newcomer cheats, that bond is slashed. A hollow swarm of fakes cannot self-bootstrap, since every fresh identity demands a real staker risking value. Like jade cut slowly from rough shale, standing accrues only through time and expense. Forging a thousand sybils means locking a thousand bonds, and watching them all burn the instant one is caught.
